mapper.update: UPDATE TimecardInfo ti SET status=#{status}, totalHours = ifnull((select sec_to_time(sum(Time_to_sec(workingHours))) from TimecardDayDetails tcdd where tcdd.tcid=ti.tcId and recordType='Active' ),'00:00:00') WHERE tcId=#{tcId} and empId=#{empId}
UPDATE TimecardDayInfo SET status = #{status}, lastModifiedOn = now() WHERE tcdId=#{tcdId} and tcId = #{tcId} and workingDate= #{workingDate}

UPDATE TimecardDayInfo tcdi SET status = #{status}, totalWeekWorkHours =ifnull((select sec_to_time(sum(Time_to_sec(workingHours))) from TimecardDayDetails tcdd where tcdi.tcId=tcdd.tcId and tcdi.tcdId=tcdd.tcdid and recordType='Active' ),'00:00:00') WHERE tcdId=#{tcdId} and tcId = #{tcId} and workingDate= #{workingDate}
mapper.select: select ifnull( (select tcdId from TimecardDayInfo where tcId = #{tcId} and workingDate=#{workingDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} limit 0,1),-1) from dual;
mapper.update: UPDATE TimecardDayDetails SET projectId=#{projectId}, activityId=#{activityId}, location=#{location}, startTime=#{startTime}, endTime=#{endTime}, workingHours=#{workingHours}, status =#{status}, taskDetails=#{taskDetails}, lastModifiedOn = now() WHERE tcddId=#{tcddId} and tcdId=#{tcdId} and tcId = #{tcId}
UPDATE TimecardDayDetails SET status =#{status}, taskDetails=#{taskDetails}, lastModifiedOn = now() WHERE tcId = #{tcId} and projectId=#{projectId}
UPDATE TimecardDayDetails SET recordType='Discard', lastModifiedOn = now() WHERE tcId = #{tcId}
mapper.select: select ifnull((select tcddId from TimecardDayDetails where tcddId not in (#{tcddId}) and tcdId=#{tcdId} and tcId = #{tcId} and starttime between #{startTime} and #{endTime} union select tcddId from TimecardDayDetails where tcddId not in (#{tcddId}) and tcdId=#{tcdId} and tcId = #{tcId} and endtime between #{startTime} and #{endTime} limit 0,1),-1) from dual
select ifnull((select group_concat(tcdId) from TimecardDayDetails where tcId = #{tcId} and activityId='18'),-1) from dual

select Date_format(tcdi.workingDate,'%d %b') workingdate,tcdd.tcid tcId,tcdd.tcdid tcdId, tcdd.projectid projectId,tcdd.activityId activityId , tcdd.location location , sec_to_time(sum(Time_to_sec(workingHours))) weekWorkingHours, ifnull((select concat(firstName,' ',middleName,' ',lastName) from EmployeeInfo where empId=approverId),' ') managerName, tcdd.status status,tcad.comments managerComment from TimecardDayInfo tcdi left join TimecardDayDetails tcdd on tcdi.tcdId=tcdd.tcdId left join TimecardApproverDetails tcad on tcdd.tcid=tcad.tcid and tcdd.projectid=tcad.projectid where tcdd.tcid=#{tcId} and tcdd.recordtype='Active' group by tcdd.tcdid,tcdd.projectid,tcdd.activityId ,tcdd.location order by tcdId, tcdd.projectid,tcdd.activityId ,tcdd.location
select pId projectId,tcApprover approverId,level levelId from ProjectApproverDetails where pId=#{projectId} and startDate <=#{workingDate} and endDate >=#{workingDate}

SELECT PTM.empId,ei.firstName,ei.lastName,ei.empCode,ei.designationId,ei.dob,ei.doj FROM ProjectTeamDetails PTM, ProjectApproverDetails PAD, EmployeeInfo ei WHERE Pad.TCAPPROVER=#{empId} and PAD.pId=PTM.pId AND PTM.empId <> TCAPPROVER AND ei.empId=PTM.empId and ei.status='Active';

select empId, ti.tcId, ti.empId,ti.weekStart,ti.weekEnd ,substr(DAYNAME(workingDate),1,3) dayName,workingDate, projectId, sec_to_time(sum(Time_to_sec(workingHours))) totalWeekHours,totalHours from TimecardDayDetails a, TimecardDayInfo b, TimecardInfo ti,ProjectApproverDetails where
ti.empId=#{empId} and
weekStart=#{weekStart} and
weekEnd=#{weekEnd} and
a.tcId=b.tcId and a.tcdId=b.tcdId and ti.tcId=a.tcId and ti.tcId=b.tcId and ti.status='draft' and pId=projectId group by ti.tcId, projectId,workingDate order by ti.tcId,workingDate;
select tcdId, tcId, workingDate, workingDay, totalWeekWorkHours,status from TimecardDayInfo where tcId=#{tcId}
select tcddId, tcdId, tcId,projectId,activityId,location,startTime,endTime,workingHours, status,taskDetails from TimecardDayDetails where tcdId=#{tcdId} and recordType='Active'

select tcId, weekStart, weekEnd, status, totalHours, approverId, projectGroup,empId from ( select tci.tcId tcId, tci.weekStart weekStart ,tci.weekEnd weekEnd, tci.status status , tci.totalHours totalHours, tcad.approverId approverId, tcad.projectID projectId, ifnull((select group_concat(tcadsub.projectId) from TimecardApproverDetails tcadsub where tcadsub.approverId=tcad.approverId and tcadsub.tcID=tcad.tcId),' ') projectGroup,tci.empId empId from TimecardApproverDetails tcad, TimecardInfo tci where approverId=#{approverId} and tci.tcId=tcad.tcId and tci.status='Pending' ) as Main group by 1;

select tcdd.tcId tcId, tcdd.tcdId tcdId,tcdd.projectId, convert(sec_to_time(sum(Time_to_sec(workingHours))),char) totalWeekWorkHours, tcdi.workingDate workingDate, tcdi.workingDay workingDay, tcdd.status status,tcdd.activityId,tcdd.location, ifnull((select concat(firstName,' ', middleName,' ', lastName) from TimecardApproverDetails tcad, EmployeeInfo ei where tcad.projectId=tcdd.projectId and tcad.tcId=tcdi.tcId and tcad.approverId=ei.empId),' ') as managerName from TimecardDayDetails tcdd,TimecardDayInfo tcdi where tcdd.tcId=#{tcId} and tcdd.tcId=tcdi.tcId and tcdd.tcdId=tcdi.tcdId and tcdd.projectId=#{projectId} and tcdd.recordType='Active' group by tcdid,workingDate,workingDay,status, tcdd.activityId,tcdd.location,managerName;

select distinct ti.empId,(select e.email from EmployeeInfo e where ti.empId=e.empId) email,ti.status,now() FROM TimecardInfo ti WHERE ti.weekStart BETWEEN (NOW() - INTERVAL 11 DAY) AND NOW() and UPPER(ti.status)=upper('draft');
